title: Phase 2 Gate 3 (Critic) Verdict
description: Structured Codex output for one phase-2 critic round. Engine, mode, round, plan fingerprint, and invalidated-by metadata are added by the persist step. Section bodies are markdown strings rendered verbatim under their respective headers.

blocking_reasons.description: One-line blockers keyed to file:line or exact file path. Use the literal token ARCH_RECHECK as a reason value when architecture is the root cause and a same-round Gate 2 re-entry is needed. Empty when verdict is OKAY.
